basis := CASE WHEN selected=league_today OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.nba_games game
    WHERE game.season_year=(context->>'seasonYear')::integer
      AND game.week_number BETWEEN matchup.week_number AND COALESCE(matchup.end_week_number,matchup.week_number)
      AND (game.status='InProgress' OR game.status='Final' AND game.stats_synced_at IS NULL)) THEN private.live_score_basis(p_league_id,matchup.league_season_id,
    (context->>'weekNumber')::integer,selected,matchup.id) ELSE '[]'::jsonb END

WITH matches AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT m.* FROM public.matchups m WHERE m.league_id=p_league_id AND m.league_season_id=p_season_id
      AND NOT m.is_voided AND m.week_number<=p_week AND COALESCE(m.end_week_number,m.week_number)>=p_week
  ), members AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT id, home_member_id AS member_id FROM matches UNION ALL SELECT id, away_member_id FROM matches
  ), totals AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT m.id, member.member_id, COALESCE(sum(public.compute_fantasy_points(stat.id,p_league_id)),$6) AS points
    FROM matches m JOIN members member ON member.id=m.id
    LEFT JOIN public.weekly_lineups lineup ON lineup.league_id=p_league_id AND lineup.league_season_id=p_season_id
      AND lineup.member_id=member.member_id AND lineup.week_number BETWEEN m.week_number AND COALESCE(m.end_week_number,m.week_number)
      AND lineup.slot_type NOT IN ($7,$8)
    LEFT JOIN public.league_seasons season ON season.id=p_season_id
    LEFT JOIN public.season_weeks week ON week.season_year=season.season_year AND week.week_number=lineup.week_number
    LEFT JOIN public.player_game_stats stat ON stat.player_id=lineup.player_id AND stat.game_date=lineup.game_date
      AND stat.season_year=season.season_year AND stat.game_date BETWEEN week.week_start AND week.week_end
    GROUP BY m.id,member.member_id
  ), players AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT member.id,member.member_id,lineup.player_id,lineup.game_date,$9 AS starter FROM members member JOIN matches ON matches.id=member.id
      JOIN public.weekly_lineups lineup ON lineup.member_id=member.member_id AND lineup.league_id=p_league_id
        AND lineup.league_season_id=p_season_id AND lineup.week_number BETWEEN matches.week_number AND COALESCE(matches.end_week_number,matches.week_number)
        AND lineup.slot_type NOT IN ($10,$11)
      WHERE lineup.game_date=p_date OR EXISTS(SELECT $12 FROM public.nba_games game WHERE game.game_date=lineup.game_date
        AND game.season_year=(SELECT season_year FROM public.league_seasons WHERE id=p_season_id)
        AND (game.status=$13 OR game.status=$14 AND game.stats_synced_at IS NULL))
    UNION ALL
    SELECT member.id,member.member_id,roster.player_id,p_date,$15 FROM members member
      JOIN public.roster_players roster ON roster.member_id=member.member_id AND roster.league_id=p_league_id
        AND roster.league_season_id=p_season_id
      WHERE member.id=p_detail_matchup_id AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT $16 FROM public.weekly_lineups lineup WHERE lineup.member_id=member.member_id
        AND lineup.league_id=p_league_id AND lineup.league_season_id=p_season_id AND lineup.game_date=p_date
        AND lineup.player_id=roster.player_id AND lineup.slot_type NOT IN ($17,$18))
  ), memberships AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT membership.*,game.game_date AS live_date FROM private.player_game_memberships membership JOIN public.nba_games game ON game.id=membership.game_id
      WHERE game.season_year=(SELECT season_year FROM public.league_seasons WHERE id=p_season_id)
        AND game.game_date IN (SELECT game_date FROM players)
  ), lines AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT selected.id,jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object($19,player.id,$20,selected.member_id,
      $21,player.nba_id,$22,player.espn_id,$23,COALESCE(membership.nba_team,player.nba_team),
      $24,game.nba_game_id,$25,selected.game_date,$26,public.compute_fantasy_points(stat.id,p_league_id),
      $27,COALESCE(extract($28 FROM feed.stats_updated_at)*$29,$30),$31,selected.starter,
      $32,game.status=$33 AND game.stats_synced_at IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY selected.member_id,player.id,game.id) AS data
    FROM players selected JOIN public.players player ON player.id=selected.player_id
    LEFT JOIN public.league_seasons season ON season.id=p_season_id
    LEFT JOIN memberships membership ON membership.player_id=player.id AND membership.live_date=selected.game_date
    LEFT JOIN public.nba_games game ON game.game_date=selected.game_date AND game.season_year=season.season_year
      AND public.is_regular_season_game_id(game.nba_game_id)
      AND (game.id=membership.game_id OR membership.game_id IS NULL AND player.nba_team IN (game.home_team,game.away_team))
    LEFT JOIN public.player_game_stats stat ON stat.player_id=player.id AND stat.game_id=game.id
    LEFT JOIN private.live_feed_state feed ON feed.game_id=game.id
    WHERE (selected.game_date=p_date OR game.status=$34 OR game.status=$35 AND game.stats_synced_at IS NULL)
      AND (game.status IS NULL OR private.lineup_game_available(game.status,game.game_status_text))
    GROUP BY selected.id
  )
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object($36,m.id,$37,m.home_member_id,$38,m.away_member_id,
    $39,COALESCE(m.home_points,$40),$41,COALESCE(m.away_points,$42),$43,COALESCE(m.is_finalized,$44),
    $45,COALESCE(m.home_points,$46)=home.points AND COALESCE(m.away_points,$47)=away.points,
    $48,COALESCE(lines.data,$49::jsonb)) ORDER BY m.id),$50::jsonb)
  FROM matches m JOIN totals home ON home.id=m.id AND home.member_id=m.home_member_id
    JOIN totals away ON away.id=m.id AND away.member_id=m.away_member_id LEFT JOIN lines ON lines.id=m.id

SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(player) || jsonb_build_object('dynasty_rank', (SELECT dynasty_rank FROM public.players WHERE id = player.id))), '[]')              FROM public.view_player_search(
    p_query := COALESCE(p_params->>'query', ''), p_position := COALESCE(p_params->>'position', 'ALL'),
    p_teams := ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(p_params->'teams', '[]'))), p_league_id := p_league_id,
    p_playing_teams := CASE WHEN p_params->>'playing' = 'today' THEN ARRAY(SELECT home_team FROM public.nba_games WHERE game_date = (context->>'today')::date UNION SELECT away_team FROM public.nba_games WHERE game_date = (context->>'today')::date) WHEN p_params ? 'playingTeams' THEN ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(p_params->'playingTeams')) END,
    p_excluded_teams := CASE WHEN p_params->>'playing' = 'not_today' THEN ARRAY(SELECT home_team FROM public.nba_games WHERE game_date = (context->>'today')::date UNION SELECT away_team FROM public.nba_games WHERE game_date = (context->>'today')::date) ELSE ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(p_params->'excludedTeams', '[]'))) END,
    p_include_player_ids := include_ids, p_exclude_player_ids := exclude_ids,
    p_rookies_only := COALESCE((p_params->>'rookiesOnly')::boolean, false), p_health := COALESCE(p_params->>'health', 'all'),
    p_sort_by := COALESCE(p_params->>'sortBy', 'fpts'), p_sort_dir := COALESCE(p_params->>'sortDir', 'desc'),
    p_season_year := (p_params->>'seasonYear')::integer, p_limit := page_size,
    p_stats_days := (p_params->>'statsDays')::integer,
    p_offset := GREATEST(COALESCE((p_params->>'offset')::integer, 0), 0)) player

WITH args AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_query, '')), '') AS query_text,
    CASE COALESCE(p_position, 'ALL')
      WHEN 'ALL' THEN ARRAY[]::text[]
      WHEN 'G' THEN ARRAY['PG', 'SG']::text[]
      WHEN 'F' THEN ARRAY['SF', 'PF']::text[]
      ELSE ARRAY[p_position]::text[]
    END AS pos_filter,
    CASE
      WHEN p_playing_teams IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(COALESCE(p_teams, '{}')) > 0 THEN
          ARRAY(
            SELECT explicit_team
            FROM unnest(COALESCE(p_teams, '{}')) AS explicit_team
            WHERE explicit_team = ANY(COALESCE(p_playing_teams, '{}'))
            ORDER BY explicit_team
          )
      WHEN p_playing_teams IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(p_playing_teams, '{}')
      ELSE COALESCE(p_teams, '{}')
    END AS effective_teams,
    (p_playing_teams IS NOT NULL OR cardinality(COALESCE(p_teams, '{}')) > 0) AS team_filter_active,
    COALESCE(p_excluded_teams, '{}') AS excluded_teams,
    COALESCE(p_exclude_player_ids, '{}') AS exclude_player_ids,
    LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit, 20), 1), 100) AS page_limit,
    GREATEST(COALESCE(p_offset, 0), 0) AS page_offset
),
current_averages AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT * FROM public.player_window_averages(p_league_id, p_stats_days, p_include_player_ids)
  WHERE p_stats_days IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT cached.player_id, cached.season_year, cached.avg_fantasy_points,
    (cached.averages->>'avg_points')::numeric AS avg_points,
    (cached.averages->>'avg_rebounds')::numeric AS avg_rebounds,
    (cached.averages->>'avg_assists')::numeric AS avg_assists,
    (cached.averages->>'avg_steals')::numeric AS avg_steals,
    (cached.averages->>'avg_blocks')::numeric AS avg_blocks,
    (cached.averages->>'avg_turnovers')::numeric AS avg_turnovers,
    (cached.averages->>'avg_three_pointers_made')::numeric AS avg_three_pointers_made,
    (cached.averages->>'avg_minutes_played')::numeric AS avg_minutes_played,
    (cached.averages->>'games_played')::integer AS games_played
  FROM public.player_season_averages cached
  WHERE p_stats_days IS NULL AND cached.league_id = p_league_id AND cached.season_year = v_stats_season
    AND v_stats_season = v_current_season AND cached.averages IS NOT NULL
    AND (p_include_player_ids IS NULL OR cached.player_id = ANY(p_include_player_ids))
),
season_averages AS (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    season_year,
    avg_points,
    avg_rebounds,
    avg_assists,
    avg_steals,
    avg_blocks,
    avg_turnovers,
    avg_three_pointers_made,
    avg_minutes_played,
    games_played
  FROM current_averages
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    player_id,
    season_year,
    avg_points,
    avg_rebounds,
    avg_assists,
    avg_steals,
    avg_blocks,
    avg_turnovers,
    avg_three_pointers_made,
    avg_minutes_played,
    games_played
  FROM public.mv_player_season_averages
  WHERE p_stats_days IS NULL AND season_year = v_stats_season AND v_stats_season <> v_current_season
),
league_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT fp.player_id, fp.avg_fantasy_points
  FROM public.v_player_avg_fantasy_points AS fp
  WHERE p_stats_days IS NULL AND fp.league_id = p_league_id
    AND fp.season_year = v_stats_season
    AND v_stats_season <> v_current_season
    AND (p_include_player_ids IS NULL OR fp.player_id = ANY(p_include_player_ids))
),
score_source AS (
  SELECT player_id, avg_fantasy_points FROM current_averages
  UNION ALL
  SELECT fp.player_id, fp.avg_fantasy_points
  FROM public.v_player_avg_fantasy_points AS fp
  WHERE p_stats_days IS NULL AND fp.league_id = p_league_id
    AND fp.season_year = v_stats_season
    AND v_stats_season <> v_current_season
    AND NOT COALESCE(p_health IN ('healthy', 'gtd', 'out', 'ir'), false)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT fp.player_id, fp.avg_fantasy_points
  FROM league_scores AS fp
  WHERE p_health IN ('healthy', 'gtd', 'out', 'ir')
),
filtered_base AS (
  SELECT
    p.id,
    COALESCE(p.display_name, concat_ws(' ', p.first_name, p.last_name)) AS display_name,
    p.nba_team,
    p.position::text AS "position",
    ARRAY(SELECT pos::text FROM unnest(p.eligible_positions) AS pos) AS eligible_positions,
    p.status,
    p.injury_status,
    p.headshot_url,
    p.nba_id,
    p.years_exp,
    p.dynasty_rank,
    p.career_regular_season_games,
    p.birthdate,
    p.injury_reason,
    p.injury_expected_return,
    fp.avg_fantasy_points,
    avg.avg_points,
    avg.avg_rebounds,
    avg.avg_assists,
    avg.avg_steals,
    avg.avg_blocks,
    avg.avg_turnovers,
    avg.avg_three_pointers_made,
    avg.avg_minutes_played,
    CASE WHEN p_stats_days IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(avg.games_played, 0) ELSE avg.games_played END::int AS games_played
  FROM args
  JOIN public.players AS p ON true
  LEFT JOIN season_averages AS avg
    ON avg.player_id = p.id
   AND (p_stats_days IS NOT NULL OR avg.season_year = v_stats_season)
  LEFT JOIN score_source AS fp
    ON fp.player_id = p.id
  WHERE
    (args.query_text IS NULL OR p.display_name ILIKE ('%' || args.query_text || '%'))
    AND (cardinality(args.pos_filter) = 0 OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM unnest(p.eligible_positions) AS player_position
      WHERE player_position::text = ANY(args.pos_filter)
    ))
    AND (NOT args.team_filter_active OR (cardinality(args.effective_teams) > 0 AND p.nba_team = ANY(args.effective_teams)))
    AND (cardinality(args.excluded_teams) = 0 OR p.nba_team IS NULL OR p.nba_team <> ALL(args.excluded_teams))
    AND (p_include_player_ids IS NULL OR p.id = ANY(p_include_player_ids))
    AND (cardinality(args.exclude_player_ids) = 0 OR p.id <> ALL(args.exclude_player_ids))
    AND (NOT p_rookies_only OR p.years_exp = 0)
    AND CASE COALESCE(p_health, 'all')
      WHEN 'healthy' THEN p.injury_status IS NULL
      WHEN 'gtd' THEN p.injury_status = ANY(ARRAY['GTD', 'DTD', 'Questionable', 'Game Time Decision'])
      WHEN 'out' THEN p.injury_status = ANY(ARRAY['Out', 'OUT', 'O'])
      WHEN 'ir' THEN p.injury_status = ANY(ARRAY['IR', 'IR-LTI'])
      ELSE true
    END
),
paged_base AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM (
    SELECT
      filtered_base.*,
      row_number() OVER (
        ORDER BY
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'dynasty' THEN filtered_base.dynasty_rank END ASC NULLS LAST,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'dynasty' AND filtered_base.dynasty_rank IS NULL THEN filtered_base.avg_fantasy_points END DESC NULLS LAST,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'fpts' AND p_sort_dir = 'asc' THEN filtered_base.avg_fantasy_points END ASC NULLS LAST,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'fpts' AND p_sort_dir <> 'asc' THEN filtered_base.avg_fantasy_points END DESC NULLS LAST,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'min' AND p_sort_dir = 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_minutes_played, 0) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'min' AND p_sort_dir <> 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_minutes_played, 0) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'pts' AND p_sort_dir = 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_points, 0) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'pts' AND p_sort_dir <> 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_points, 0) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'reb' AND p_sort_dir = 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_rebounds, 0) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'reb' AND p_sort_dir <> 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_rebounds, 0) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'ast' AND p_sort_dir = 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_assists, 0) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'ast' AND p_sort_dir <> 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_assists, 0) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'stl' AND p_sort_dir = 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_steals, 0) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'stl' AND p_sort_dir <> 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_steals, 0) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'blk' AND p_sort_dir = 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_blocks, 0) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'blk' AND p_sort_dir <> 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_blocks, 0) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'tpm' AND p_sort_dir = 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_three_pointers_made, 0) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'tpm' AND p_sort_dir <> 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_three_pointers_made, 0) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'to' AND p_sort_dir = 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_turnovers, 0) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'to' AND p_sort_dir <> 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_turnovers, 0) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'gp' AND p_sort_dir = 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.games_played, 0) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'gp' AND p_sort_dir <> 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.games_played, 0) END DESC,
          filtered_base.display_name ASC,
          filtered_base.id ASC
      ) AS page_rank
    FROM filtered_base
  ) ranked_base
  ORDER BY page_rank
  LIMIT (SELECT page_limit FROM args)
  OFFSET (SELECT page_offset FROM args)
),
projection AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM public.get_league_projection_rows(
    p_league_id,
    v_stats_season,
    (timezone('America/New_York', now()))::date,
    'today',
    COALESCE((SELECT array_agg(paged_base.id ORDER BY paged_base.id) FROM paged_base), ARRAY[]::uuid[]),
    (SELECT page_limit FROM args),
    0
  )
  WHERE p_league_id IS NOT NULL
)

WITH pgrst_source AS (SELECT pgrst_call.pgrst_scalar FROM (SELECT $1 AS json_data) pgrst_payload, LATERAL (SELECT "p_league_id", "p_member_id", "p_params" FROM json_to_record(pgrst_payload.json_data) AS _("p_league_id" uuid, "p_member_id" uuid, "p_params" jsonb) LIMIT 1) pgrst_body , LATERAL (SELECT "public"."view_trades"("p_league_id" := pgrst_body."p_league_id", "p_member_id" := pgrst_body."p_member_id", "p_params" := pgrst_body."p_params") pgrst_scalar) pgrst_call) SELECT null::bigint AS total_result_set, 1 AS page_total, coalesce(json_agg(_postgrest_t.pgrst_scalar)->0, 'null') AS body, nullif(current_setting('response.headers', true), '') AS response_headers, nullif(current_setting('response.status', true), '') AS response_status, '' AS response_inserted FROM (SELECT "view_trades".* FROM "pgrst_source" AS "view_trades"   LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3) _postgrest_t

rows := public.get_trade_cards(p_league_id,p_member_id,ARRAY(
    SELECT (ref->>'trade_id')::uuid FROM jsonb_array_elements(refs) WITH ORDINALITY refs(ref,ordinal)
    WHERE ordinal<=page_size ORDER BY ordinal))

WITH own_members AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT id FROM public.league_members WHERE league_id=p_league_id AND user_id=auth.uid()
  ), requested AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT id,ordinal FROM unnest(p_trade_ids) WITH ORDINALITY row(id,ordinal)
  ), chosen AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT trade.* FROM public.trades trade WHERE trade.league_id=p_league_id AND trade.id=ANY(p_trade_ids)
      AND (trade.status IN ('accepted','completed') OR trade.proposer_member_id IN(SELECT id FROM own_members)
        OR trade.recipient_member_id IN(SELECT id FROM own_members)
        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.trade_participants participant WHERE participant.trade_id=trade.id
          AND participant.member_id IN(SELECT id FROM own_members)))
  ), cached_values AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT cached.trade_id, value.* FROM chosen trade
    JOIN public.trade_value_cache cached ON cached.trade_id=trade.id
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_record(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(cached.revaluation)='object'
      THEN cached.revaluation ELSE '{}'::jsonb END)
      value("modelVersion" text,"inputVersion" text,"createdAt" text,analysis jsonb)
    WHERE value."modelVersion"='onenumber-trade-curve-v6'
  ), participants AS (
    SELECT participant.trade_id,COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('memberId',participant.member_id,

      'dropPlayerIds',participant.drop_player_ids,'rosterMoves',participant.roster_moves)
      ORDER BY participant.sort_order,member.team_name,participant.member_id),'[]') AS value
    FROM chosen trade JOIN public.trade_participants participant ON participant.trade_id=trade.id
    LEFT JOIN public.league_members member ON member.id=participant.member_id AND member.league_id=p_league_id
    GROUP BY participant.trade_id
  ), pick_values AS MATERIALIZED (

    WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM chosen trade JOIN public.trade_items item ON item.trade_id=trade.id

  ), player_data AS MATERIALIZED (

      (SELECT ranking.trade_value FROM public.dynasty_rankings ranking WHERE ranking.player_id=player.id
        AND ranking.source='onenumberhoops.com' ORDER BY ranking.fetched_at DESC,ranking.source_rank LIMIT 1) AS trade_value,
      COALESCE(average.avg_fantasy_points,source_fantasy.avg_fantasy_points) AS avg_fantasy_points,
      COALESCE(average.averages->'avg_minutes_played',to_jsonb(source_average.avg_minutes_played)) AS avg_minutes_played
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT item.player_id FROM chosen trade JOIN public.trade_items item ON item.trade_id=trade.id
      WHERE item.player_id IS NOT NULL) selected
    JOIN public.players player ON player.id=selected.player_id
    LEFT JOIN public.player_season_averages average ON average.league_id = p_league_id AND average.player_id = player.id
      AND average.season_year = current_year
    LEFT JOIN public.mv_player_season_averages source_average ON average.player_id IS NULL AND source_average.player_id = player.id
      AND source_average.season_year = current_year
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT fantasy.avg_fantasy_points FROM public.v_player_avg_fantasy_points fantasy
      WHERE average.player_id IS NULL AND fantasy.league_id=p_league_id
        AND fantasy.player_id=player.id AND fantasy.season_year=current_year
      OFFSET 0
    ) source_fantasy ON true
  ), items AS (
    SELECT item.trade_id, COALESCE(jsonb_agg(CASE WHEN item.player_id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object('kind', 'player',
      'tradeValue', player.trade_value,
      'playerId', player.id, 'playerName', COALESCE(player.display_name, 'Unknown'), 'position', player.position,
      'eligiblePositions', player.eligible_positions, 'nbaTeam', player.nba_team, 'nbaId', player.nba_id,
      'injuryStatus', player.injury_status, 'yearsExp', player.years_exp, 'nbaDraftNumber', player.nba_draft_number,
      'careerGames', player.career_regular_season_games, 'toTaxi', item.to_taxi, 'toIR', item.to_ir,
      'fromTaxi', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.roster_players r WHERE r.player_id = player.id AND r.member_id = item.from_member_id
        AND r.league_season_id = trade.league_season_id AND r.is_on_taxi),
      'avgFantasyPoints', player.avg_fantasy_points,
      'avgMinutesPlayed', player.avg_minutes_played)
    WHEN item.pick_id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object('kind', 'pick', 'pickId', pick.id, 'seasonYear', pick.season_year,
      'tradeValue', COALESCE(pick.predicted_trade_value,(SELECT value.trade_value FROM pick_values value
        WHERE value.draft_year=pick.season_year-1 AND value.round=pick.round AND value.tier=CASE
          WHEN slot.pick_in_round IS NULL THEN 'mid'
          WHEN slot.pick_in_round<=ceil(GREATEST(4,teams)/3.0) THEN 'early'
          WHEN slot.pick_in_round<=ceil(GREATEST(4,teams)*2/3.0) THEN 'mid'
          ELSE 'late' END)),
      'round', pick.round, 'originalTeamName', COALESCE(original.team_name, 'Unknown'))
    ELSE jsonb_build_object('kind', 'faab', 'amount', item.faab_amount) END
    || jsonb_build_object('fromMemberId', item.from_member_id, 'toMemberId', item.to_member_id) ORDER BY item.id), '[]')
    AS value FROM public.trade_items item JOIN chosen trade ON trade.id=item.trade_id LEFT JOIN player_data player ON player.id = item.player_id
    LEFT JOIN public.draft_picks pick ON pick.id = item.pick_id AND pick.league_id=p_league_id LEFT JOIN public.league_members original ON original.id = pick.original_owner_id AND original.league_id=p_league_id
    LEFT JOIN public.snake_draft_picks slot ON slot.draft_pick_id=pick.id

    GROUP BY item.trade_id

  )
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(CASE WHEN trade.id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object('id', trade.id, 'status', trade.status, 'completionFailureReason', trade.completion_failure_reason,
    'proposedAt', trade.proposed_at, 'acceptedAt', trade.accepted_at, 'vetoWindowExpiresAt', trade.veto_window_expires_at,
    'completedAt', trade.completed_at, 'vetoedAt', trade.vetoed_at, 'expiresAt', trade.expires_at, 'notes', trade.notes,
    'proposerMemberId', trade.proposer_member_id, 'proposerTeamName', COALESCE((SELECT team_name FROM public.league_members WHERE id = trade.proposer_member_id), 'Unknown'),
    'recipientMemberId', trade.recipient_member_id, 'recipientTeamName', COALESCE((SELECT team_name FROM public.league_members WHERE id = trade.recipient_member_id), 'Unknown'),
    'isMultiTeam', trade.is_multi_team, 'participants', COALESCE(participants.value,'[]'::jsonb), 'parentTradeId', trade.parent_trade_id,
    'counteredFromTradeId', trade.countered_from_trade_id, 'editedFromTradeId', trade.edited_from_trade_id, 'replacedByTradeId', trade.replaced_by_trade_id,
    'version', trade.version, 'proposerFaabAmount', trade.proposer_faab_amount, 'recipientFaabAmount', trade.recipient_faab_amount,
    'myVetoed', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.trade_vetos WHERE trade_id = trade.id AND member_id = p_member_id),
    'routedItems', COALESCE(items.value,'[]'::jsonb), 'estimate', CASE WHEN quote.id IS NOT NULL OR cached.trade_id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object('quoteId',quote.id,'modelVersion',COALESCE(cached."modelVersion",quote.model_version),'inputVersion',COALESCE(cached."inputVersion",quote.input_version),'createdAt',COALESCE(cached."createdAt",quote.created_at::text),'teams',COALESCE(cached.analysis->'teams',quote.analysis->'teams'),'assets',COALESCE(cached.analysis->'assets',quote.analysis->'assets')) END, 'estimateUnavailable', recorded.unavailable_reason) END ORDER BY requested.ordinal),'[]')
             FROM requested LEFT JOIN chosen trade ON trade.id=requested.id
    LEFT JOIN participants ON participants.trade_id=trade.id LEFT JOIN items ON items.trade_id=trade.id
    LEFT JOIN public.trade_estimates recorded ON recorded.trade_id=trade.id
    LEFT JOIN public.trade_estimate_quotes quote ON quote.id=recorded.quote_id
    LEFT JOIN cached_values cached ON cached.trade_id=trade.id

WITH pgrst_source AS (SELECT pgrst_call.pgrst_scalar FROM (SELECT $1 AS json_data) pgrst_payload, LATERAL (SELECT "p_league_id", "p_member_id", "p_params" FROM json_to_record(pgrst_payload.json_data) AS _("p_league_id" uuid, "p_member_id" uuid, "p_params" jsonb) LIMIT 1) pgrst_body , LATERAL (SELECT "public"."view_league"("p_league_id" := pgrst_body."p_league_id", "p_member_id" := pgrst_body."p_member_id", "p_params" := pgrst_body."p_params") pgrst_scalar) pgrst_call) SELECT null::bigint AS total_result_set, 1 AS page_total, coalesce(json_agg(_postgrest_t.pgrst_scalar)->0, 'null') AS body, nullif(current_setting('response.headers', true), '') AS response_headers, nullif(current_setting('response.status', true), '') AS response_status, '' AS response_inserted FROM (SELECT "view_league".* FROM "pgrst_source" AS "view_league"   LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3) _postgrest_t

SELECT pgs.*                  FROM public.player_game_stats pgs

WITH args AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN p_view IN ('today', 'week_avg', 'week_total') THEN p_view ELSE 'today' END AS view_name,
    COALESCE(p_game_date, (timezone('America/New_York', now()))::date) AS game_date,
    LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit, 600), 1), 1000) AS page_limit,
    GREATEST(COALESCE(p_offset, 0), 0) AS page_offset
),
league AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    scoring_settings,
    (
      COALESCE((scoring_settings->>'field_goals_made')::numeric, 0) <> 0 OR
      COALESCE((scoring_settings->>'field_goals_attempted')::numeric, 0) <> 0 OR
      COALESCE((scoring_settings->>'free_throws_made')::numeric, 0) <> 0 OR
      COALESCE((scoring_settings->>'free_throws_attempted')::numeric, 0) <> 0
    ) AS uses_fantasypros_unsupported_scoring
  FROM public.leagues
  WHERE id = p_league_id
),
week_ctx AS (
  SELECT sw.week_number, sw.week_start, sw.week_end
  FROM args
  JOIN public.season_weeks sw
    ON sw.season_year = p_season_year
   AND sw.week_start <= args.game_date
   AND sw.week_end >= args.game_date
  LIMIT 1
),
base_players AS (
  SELECT
    p.id,
    COALESCE(p.display_name, concat_ws(' ', p.first_name, p.last_name)) AS display_name,
    p.nba_team,
    p.position::text AS "position",
    ARRAY(SELECT pos::text FROM unnest(p.eligible_positions) AS pos) AS eligible_positions,
    p.injury_status,
    p.headshot_url,
    p.nba_id
  FROM (
    SELECT * FROM public.players WHERE p_player_ids IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM public.players WHERE p_player_ids IS NOT NULL AND id = ANY(p_player_ids)
  ) p
),
regular_games AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT id, game_date, home_team, away_team, game_time, status, started_at
  FROM public.nba_games
  WHERE season_year = p_season_year AND public.is_regular_season_game_id(nba_game_id)
),
upcoming_games AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT ng.id, ng.game_date, ng.home_team, ng.away_team, ng.game_time
  FROM args
  JOIN regular_games ng
    ON ng.game_date >= args.game_date
   AND ng.status NOT IN ('InProgress', 'Final')
   AND (ng.game_time IS NULL OR ng.game_time > now())
   AND (ng.started_at IS NULL OR ng.started_at > now())
),
team_next_games AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (teams.nba_team) teams.nba_team, g.game_date, g.home_team, g.away_team, g.game_time
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT nba_team FROM base_players WHERE nba_team IS NOT NULL) teams
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT home_team AS nba_team, id, game_date, home_team, away_team, game_time FROM upcoming_games
    UNION ALL
    SELECT away_team, id, game_date, home_team, away_team, game_time FROM upcoming_games
  ) g ON g.nba_team = teams.nba_team
  ORDER BY teams.nba_team, g.game_date ASC, g.game_time ASC NULLS LAST, g.id ASC
),
next_games AS (
  SELECT
    bp.id AS player_id,
    g.game_date AS next_game_date,
    CASE
      WHEN g.home_team = bp.nba_team THEN 'vs ' || COALESCE(g.away_team, '?')
      WHEN g.away_team = bp.nba_team THEN '@ ' || COALESCE(g.home_team, '?')
      ELSE NULL
    END AS next_game_opponent,
    g.game_time AS next_game_time
  FROM base_players bp
  LEFT JOIN team_next_games g ON g.nba_team = bp.nba_team
),
week_game_counts AS (
  SELECT
    bp.id AS player_id,
    COUNT(ng.id)::int AS scheduled_games
  FROM base_players bp
  JOIN week_ctx wc ON true
  JOIN public.nba_games ng
    ON ng.season_year = p_season_year
   AND ng.week_number = wc.week_number
   AND public.is_regular_season_game_id(ng.nba_game_id)
   AND bp.nba_team IS NOT NULL
   AND (ng.home_team = bp.nba_team OR ng.away_team = bp.nba_team)
  GROUP BY bp.id
),
latest_daily_run AS (
  SELECT latest_run.id
  FROM args
  JOIN public.projection_sync_runs latest_run
    ON latest_run.source = 'fantasypros'
   AND latest_run.projection_type = 'daily'
   AND latest_run.projection_date = args.game_date
   AND latest_run.status = 'success'

  ORDER BY latest_run.started_at DESC, latest_run.id DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
latest_weekly_avg_run AS (
  SELECT latest_run.id

    ON latest_run.source = 'fantasypros'
   AND latest_run.projection_type = 'weekly_avg'
   AND latest_run.season_year = p_season_year
   AND (wc.week_number IS NULL OR latest_run.week_number IS NULL OR latest_run.week_number = wc.week_number)
   AND latest_run.status = 'success'
   AND latest_run.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY latest_run.week_number DESC NULLS LAST, latest_run.started_at DESC, latest_run.id DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
latest_weekly_total_run AS (
  SELECT latest_run.id
  FROM args
  LEFT JOIN week_ctx wc ON true
  JOIN public.projection_sync_runs latest_run
    ON latest_run.source = 'fantasypros'
   AND latest_run.projection_type = 'weekly_total'
   AND latest_run.season_year = p_season_year
   AND (wc.week_number IS NULL OR latest_run.week_number IS NULL OR latest_run.week_number = wc.week_number)
   AND latest_run.status = 'success'
   AND latest_run.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY latest_run.week_number DESC NULLS LAST, latest_run.started_at DESC, latest_run.id DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
daily_candidates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.player_id)
    r.player_id,
    'fantasypros_daily'::text AS projection_source,
    'FantasyPros Daily'::text AS projection_source_label,
    'today'::text AS projection_view,
    public.projection_stat_fantasy_points(
      r.points, r.rebounds, r.assists, r.steals, r.blocks, r.three_pointers_made, r.turnovers,
      NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric,
      l.scoring_settings
    ) AS projection_fantasy_points,
    r.minutes AS projection_minutes,
    r.points AS projection_points,
    r.rebounds AS projection_rebounds,
    r.assists AS projection_assists,
    r.steals AS projection_steals,
    r.blocks AS projection_blocks,
    r.three_pointers_made AS projection_three_pointers_made,
    r.turnovers AS projection_turnovers,
    r.games_played AS projection_games_played,

    r.projection_date,

  FROM args

    ON r.projection_type = 'daily'
   AND r.match_status = 'matched'
   AND r.player_id IS NOT NULL
   AND r.projection_date = args.game_date
   AND r.fetched_at >= now() - interval '36 hours'
  JOIN latest_daily_run ldr
    ON ldr.id = r.run_id
  JOIN base_players projected_player
    ON projected_player.id = r.player_id
  JOIN public.projection_sync_runs psr
    ON psr.id = r.run_id
   AND psr.status = 'success'
   AND psr.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  WHERE args.view_name = 'today'
    AND NOT l.uses_fantasypros_unsupported_scoring
  ORDER BY r.player_id, r.fetched_at DESC, r.run_id DESC
),
weekly_avg_candidates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.player_id)
    r.player_id,
    CASE
      WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' THEN 'fantasypros_weekly_avg_total'
      ELSE 'fantasypros_weekly_avg'
    END::text AS projection_source,
    CASE
      WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' THEN 'FantasyPros Week Avg x GP'
      ELSE 'FantasyPros Week Avg'
    END::text AS projection_source_label,
    CASE
      WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' THEN 'week_total'
      ELSE 'week_avg'
    END::text AS projection_view,
    public.projection_stat_fantasy_points(
      r.points * m.games_multiplier,
      r.rebounds * m.games_multiplier,
      r.assists * m.games_multiplier,
      r.steals * m.games_multiplier,
      r.blocks * m.games_multiplier,
      r.three_pointers_made * m.games_multiplier,
      r.turnovers * m.games_multiplier,
      NULL::numeric,
      NULL::numeric,
      NULL::numeric,
      NULL::numeric,
      CASE
        WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' AND m.games_multiplier > 0 AND (
          (COALESCE(r.points, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.rebounds, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.assists, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.steals, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.blocks, 0) >= 10)::int
        ) >= 2 THEN m.games_multiplier
        WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' THEN 0::numeric
        ELSE NULL::numeric
      END,
      CASE
        WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' AND m.games_multiplier > 0 AND (
          (COALESCE(r.points, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.rebounds, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.assists, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.steals, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.blocks, 0) >= 10)::int
        ) >= 3 THEN m.games_multiplier
        WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' THEN 0::numeric
        ELSE NULL::numeric
      END,
      l.scoring_settings
    ) AS projection_fantasy_points,
    r.minutes * m.games_multiplier AS projection_minutes,
    r.points * m.games_multiplier AS projection_points,
    r.rebounds * m.games_multiplier AS projection_rebounds,
    r.assists * m.games_multiplier AS projection_assists,
    r.steals * m.games_multiplier AS projection_steals,
    r.blocks * m.games_multiplier AS projection_blocks,
    r.three_pointers_made * m.games_multiplier AS projection_three_pointers_made,
    r.turnovers * m.games_multiplier AS projection_turnovers,
    CASE WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' THEN m.games_multiplier::int ELSE r.games_played END AS projection_games_played,
    r.field_goal_pct AS projection_field_goal_pct,
    r.free_throw_pct AS projection_free_throw_pct,
    r.source_status AS projection_status,
    r.fetched_at AS projection_fetched_at,
    r.projection_date,
    r.week_number AS projection_week_number,
    true AS projection_is_fresh,
    CASE WHEN args.view_name = 'week_avg' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS priority
  FROM args
  JOIN league l ON true
  LEFT JOIN week_ctx wc ON true
  JOIN public.fantasypros_projection_rows r
    ON r.projection_type = 'weekly_avg'
   AND r.match_status = 'matched'
   AND r.player_id IS NOT NULL
   AND r.season_year = p_season_year
   AND (wc.week_number IS NULL OR r.week_number IS NULL OR r.week_number = wc.week_number)
   AND r.fetched_at >= now() - interval '8 days'
  JOIN latest_weekly_avg_run lwar
    ON lwar.id = r.run_id
  JOIN base_players projected_player
    ON projected_player.id = r.player_id
  JOIN public.projection_sync_runs psr

   AND r.season_year = p_season_year

   AND r.fetched_at >= now() - interval '8 days'
  JOIN latest_weekly_total_run lwtr

    100 * sum(free_throws_made) / NULLIF(sum(free_throws_attempted),0) AS free_throw_pct,

sleeper_candidates AS (

    ROUND((s.fantasy_points + COALESCE(b.projection_fantasy_points * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor,2) AS projection_fantasy_points,
    (s.minutes + COALESCE(b.projection_minutes * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor AS projection_minutes,
    (s.points + COALESCE(b.projection_points * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor AS projection_points,
    (s.rebounds + COALESCE(b.projection_rebounds * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor AS projection_rebounds,
    (s.assists + COALESCE(b.projection_assists * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor AS projection_assists,
    (s.steals + COALESCE(b.projection_steals * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor AS projection_steals,
    (s.blocks + COALESCE(b.projection_blocks * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor AS projection_blocks,
    (s.three_pointers_made + COALESCE(b.projection_three_pointers_made * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor AS projection_three_pointers_made,
    (s.turnovers + COALESCE(b.projection_turnovers * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor AS projection_turnovers,
    s.games + CASE WHEN b.player_id IS NOT NULL THEN m.missing_games ELSE 0 END AS projection_games_played,
    (COALESCE(s.field_goal_pct,0)*s.games + COALESCE(b.projection_field_goal_pct,0)*m.missing_games) /
      NULLIF(s.games + CASE WHEN b.projection_field_goal_pct IS NOT NULL THEN m.missing_games ELSE 0 END,0) AS projection_field_goal_pct,
    (COALESCE(s.free_throw_pct,0)*s.games + COALESCE(b.projection_free_throw_pct,0)*m.missing_games) /
      NULLIF(s.games + CASE WHEN b.projection_free_throw_pct IS NOT NULL THEN m.missing_games ELSE 0 END,0) AS projection_free_throw_pct,

  LEFT JOIN fallback_best b ON b.player_id=s.player_id
  LEFT JOIN week_game_counts wgc ON wgc.player_id=s.player_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT CASE WHEN args.view_name='today' THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(COALESCE(wgc.scheduled_games,0)+s.prior_team_games-s.games,0) END AS missing_games
  ) missing
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT missing.missing_games,
      CASE WHEN args.view_name='week_total' THEN missing.missing_games::numeric / NULLIF(b.projection_games_played,0)

      CASE WHEN args.view_name='week_avg' THEN s.games + CASE WHEN b.player_id IS NOT NULL THEN missing.missing_games ELSE 0 END
        ELSE 1 END::numeric AS divisor
  ) m

WITH matches AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT m.* FROM public.matchups m WHERE m.league_id=p_league_id AND m.league_season_id=p_season_id
      AND NOT m.is_voided AND m.week_number<=p_week AND COALESCE(m.end_week_number,m.week_number)>=p_week
  ), members AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT id, home_member_id AS member_id FROM matches UNION ALL SELECT id, away_member_id FROM matches
  ), totals AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT m.id, member.member_id, COALESCE(sum(public.compute_fantasy_points(stat.id,p_league_id)),$6) AS points
    FROM matches m JOIN members member ON member.id=m.id
    LEFT JOIN public.weekly_lineups lineup ON lineup.league_id=p_league_id AND lineup.league_season_id=p_season_id
      AND lineup.member_id=member.member_id AND lineup.week_number BETWEEN m.week_number AND COALESCE(m.end_week_number,m.week_number)
      AND lineup.slot_type NOT IN ($7,$8)
    LEFT JOIN public.league_seasons season ON season.id=p_season_id
    LEFT JOIN public.season_weeks week ON week.season_year=season.season_year AND week.week_number=lineup.week_number
    LEFT JOIN public.player_game_stats stat ON stat.player_id=lineup.player_id AND stat.game_date=lineup.game_date
      AND stat.season_year=season.season_year AND stat.game_date BETWEEN week.week_start AND week.week_end
    GROUP BY m.id,member.member_id
  ), players AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT member.id,member.member_id,lineup.player_id,lineup.game_date,$9 AS starter FROM members member JOIN matches ON matches.id=member.id
      JOIN public.weekly_lineups lineup ON lineup.member_id=member.member_id AND lineup.league_id=p_league_id
        AND lineup.league_season_id=p_season_id AND lineup.week_number BETWEEN matches.week_number AND COALESCE(matches.end_week_number,matches.week_number)
        AND lineup.slot_type NOT IN ($10,$11)
      WHERE lineup.game_date=p_date OR EXISTS(SELECT $12 FROM public.nba_games game WHERE game.game_date=lineup.game_date
        AND game.season_year=(SELECT season_year FROM public.league_seasons WHERE id=p_season_id)
        AND (game.status=$13 OR game.status=$14 AND game.stats_synced_at IS NULL))
    UNION ALL
    SELECT member.id,member.member_id,roster.player_id,p_date,$15 FROM members member
      JOIN public.roster_players roster ON roster.member_id=member.member_id AND roster.league_id=p_league_id
        AND roster.league_season_id=p_season_id
      WHERE member.id=p_detail_matchup_id AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT $16 FROM public.weekly_lineups lineup WHERE lineup.member_id=member.member_id
        AND lineup.league_id=p_league_id AND lineup.league_season_id=p_season_id AND lineup.game_date=p_date
        AND lineup.player_id=roster.player_id AND lineup.slot_type NOT IN ($17,$18))
  ), memberships AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT membership.*,game.game_date AS live_date FROM private.player_game_memberships membership JOIN public.nba_games game ON game.id=membership.game_id
      WHERE game.season_year=(SELECT season_year FROM public.league_seasons WHERE id=p_season_id)
        AND game.game_date IN (SELECT game_date FROM players)
  ), lines AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT selected.id,jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object($19,player.id,$20,selected.member_id,
      $21,player.nba_id,$22,player.espn_id,$23,COALESCE(membership.nba_team,player.nba_team),
      $24,game.nba_game_id,$25,selected.game_date,$26,public.compute_fantasy_points(stat.id,p_league_id),
      $27,COALESCE(extract($28 FROM feed.stats_updated_at)*$29,$30),$31,selected.starter,
      $32,game.status=$33 AND game.stats_synced_at IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY selected.member_id,player.id,game.id) AS data
    FROM players selected JOIN public.players player ON player.id=selected.player_id
    LEFT JOIN public.league_seasons season ON season.id=p_season_id
    LEFT JOIN memberships membership ON membership.player_id=player.id AND membership.live_date=selected.game_date
    LEFT JOIN public.nba_games game ON game.game_date=selected.game_date AND game.season_year=season.season_year
      AND public.is_regular_season_game_id(game.nba_game_id)
      AND (game.id=membership.game_id OR membership.game_id IS NULL AND player.nba_team IN (game.home_team,game.away_team))
    LEFT JOIN public.player_game_stats stat ON stat.player_id=player.id AND stat.game_id=game.id
    LEFT JOIN private.live_feed_state feed ON feed.game_id=game.id
    WHERE (selected.game_date=p_date OR game.status=$34 OR game.status=$35 AND game.stats_synced_at IS NULL)
      AND (game.status IS NULL OR private.lineup_game_available(game.status,game.game_status_text))
    GROUP BY selected.id
  )
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object($36,m.id,$37,m.home_member_id,$38,m.away_member_id,
    $39,COALESCE(m.home_points,$40),$41,COALESCE(m.away_points,$42),$43,COALESCE(m.is_finalized,$44),

    $48,COALESCE(lines.data,$49::jsonb)) ORDER BY m.id),$50::jsonb)
  FROM matches m JOIN totals home ON home.id=m.id AND home.member_id=m.home_member_id
    JOIN totals away ON away.id=m.id AND away.member_id=m.away_member_id LEFT JOIN lines ON lines.id=m.id

'playingTeams' THEN ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(p_params->'playingTeams')) END,
    p_excluded_teams := CASE WHEN p_params->>'playing' = 'not_today' THEN ARRAY(SELECT home_team FROM public.nba_games WHERE game_date = (context->>'today')::date UNION SELECT away_team FROM public.nba_games WHERE game_date = (context->>'today')::date) ELSE ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(p_params->'excludedTeams', '[]'))) END,
    p_include_player_ids := include_ids, p_exclude_player_ids := exclude_ids,

WITH args AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_query, '')), '') AS query_text,
    CASE COALESCE(p_position, 'ALL')
      WHEN 'ALL' THEN ARRAY[]::text[]
      WHEN 'G' THEN ARRAY['PG', 'SG']::text[]
      WHEN 'F' THEN ARRAY['SF', 'PF']::text[]
      ELSE ARRAY[p_position]::text[]
    END AS pos_filter,
    CASE
      WHEN p_playing_teams IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(COALESCE(p_teams, '{}')) > 0 THEN
          ARRAY(
            SELECT explicit_team
            FROM unnest(COALESCE(p_teams, '{}')) AS explicit_team
            WHERE explicit_team = ANY(COALESCE(p_playing_teams, '{}'))
            ORDER BY explicit_team
          )
      WHEN p_playing_teams IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(p_playing_teams, '{}')
      ELSE COALESCE(p_teams, '{}')
    END AS effective_teams,
    (p_playing_teams IS NOT NULL OR cardinality(COALESCE(p_teams, '{}')) > 0) AS team_filter_active,
    COALESCE(p_excluded_teams, '{}') AS excluded_teams,
    COALESCE(p_exclude_player_ids, '{}') AS exclude_player_ids,
    LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit, 20), 1), 100) AS page_limit,
    GREATEST(COALESCE(p_offset, 0), 0) AS page_offset
),
current_averages AS MATERIALIZED (

  WHERE p_stats_days IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT cached.player_id, cached.season_year, cached.avg_fantasy_points,

    avg_turnovers,

    avg_blocks,

league_scores AS MATERIALIZED (

  FROM public.v_player_avg_fantasy_points AS fp
  WHERE p_stats_days IS NULL AND fp.league_id = p_league_id
    AND fp.season_year = v_stats_season
    AND v_stats_season <> v_current_season
    AND (p_include_player_ids IS NULL OR fp.player_id = ANY(p_include_player_ids))
),
score_source AS (
  SELECT player_id, avg_fantasy_points FROM current_averages
  UNION ALL
  SELECT fp.player_id, fp.avg_fantasy_points
  FROM public.v_player_avg_fantasy_points AS fp
  WHERE p_stats_days IS NULL AND fp.league_id = p_league_id
    AND fp.season_year = v_stats_season
    AND v_stats_season <> v_current_season

  UNION ALL
  SELECT fp.player_id, fp.avg_fantasy_points
  FROM league_scores AS fp
  WHERE p_health IN ('healthy', 'gtd', 'out', 'ir')
),
filtered_base AS (
  SELECT
    p.id,
    COALESCE(p.display_name, concat_ws(' ', p.first_name, p.last_name)) AS display_name,
    p.nba_team,
    p.position::text AS "position",

    p.injury_status,

    p.years_exp,

    p.birthdate,
    p.injury_reason,
    p.injury_expected_return,
    fp.avg_fantasy_points,

    avg.avg_rebounds,
    avg.avg_assists,
    avg.avg_steals,
    avg.avg_blocks,
    avg.avg_turnovers,
    avg.avg_three_pointers_made,
    avg.avg_minutes_played,
    CASE WHEN p_stats_days IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(avg.games_played, 0) ELSE avg.games_played END::int AS games_played
  FROM args
  JOIN public.players AS p ON true
  LEFT JOIN season_averages AS avg
    ON avg.player_id = p.id
   AND (p_stats_days IS NOT NULL OR avg.season_year = v_stats_season)
  LEFT JOIN score_source AS fp
    ON fp.player_id = p.id
  WHERE
    (args.query_text IS NULL OR p.display_name ILIKE ('%' || args.query_text || '%'))
    AND (cardinality(args.pos_filter) = 0 OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM unnest(p.eligible_positions) AS player_position
      WHERE player_position::text = ANY(args.pos_filter)
    ))
    AND (NOT args.team_filter_active OR (cardinality(args.effective_teams) > 0 AND p.nba_team = ANY(args.effective_teams)))
    AND (cardinality(args.excluded_teams) = 0 OR p.nba_team IS NULL OR p.nba_team <> ALL(args.excluded_teams))
    AND (p_include_player_ids IS NULL OR p.id = ANY(p_include_player_ids))
    AND (cardinality(args.exclude_player_ids) = 0 OR p.id <> ALL(args.exclude_player_ids))
    AND (NOT p_rookies_only OR p.years_exp = 0)
    AND CASE COALESCE(p_health, 'all')
      WHEN 'healthy' THEN p.injury_status IS NULL
      WHEN 'gtd' THEN p.injury_status = ANY(ARRAY['GTD', 'DTD', 'Questionable', 'Game Time Decision'])
      WHEN 'out' THEN p.injury_status = ANY(ARRAY['Out', 'OUT', 'O'])
      WHEN 'ir' THEN p.injury_status = ANY(ARRAY['IR', 'IR-LTI'])
      ELSE true
    END
),
paged_base AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM (
    SELECT
      filtered_base.*,
      row_number() OVER (
        ORDER BY
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'dynasty' THEN filtered_base.dynasty_rank END ASC NULLS LAST,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'dynasty' AND filtered_base.dynasty_rank IS NULL THEN filtered_base.avg_fantasy_points END DESC NULLS LAST,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'fpts' AND p_sort_dir = 'asc' THEN filtered_base.avg_fantasy_points END ASC NULLS LAST,

          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'reb' AND p_sort_dir = 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_rebounds, 0) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'reb' AND p_sort_dir <> 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_rebounds, 0) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'ast' AND p_sort_dir = 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_assists, 0) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'ast' AND p_sort_dir <> 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_assists, 0) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'stl' AND p_sort_dir = 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_steals, 0) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'stl' AND p_sort_dir <> 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_steals, 0) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'blk' AND p_sort_dir = 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_blocks, 0) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'blk' AND p_sort_dir <> 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_blocks, 0) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'tpm' AND p_sort_dir = 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_three_pointers_made, 0) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'tpm' AND p_sort_dir <> 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_three_pointers_made, 0) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'to' AND p_sort_dir = 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_turnovers, 0) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'to' AND p_sort_dir <> 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_turnovers, 0) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'gp' AND p_sort_dir = 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.games_played, 0) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'gp' AND p_sort_dir <> 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.games_played, 0) END DESC,
          filtered_base.display_name ASC,
          filtered_base.id ASC
      ) AS page_rank
    FROM filtered_base
  ) ranked_base
  ORDER BY page_rank
  LIMIT (SELECT page_limit FROM args)
  OFFSET (SELECT page_offset FROM args)
),
projection AS (

  ), chosen AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT trade.* FROM public.trades trade WHERE trade.league_id=p_league_id AND trade.id=ANY(p_trade_ids)
      AND (trade.status IN ('accepted','completed') OR trade.proposer_member_id IN(SELECT id FROM own_members)

          ELSE 'late' END)),
      'round', pick.round, 'originalTeamName', COALESCE(original.team_name, 'Unknown'))
    ELSE jsonb_build_object('kind', 'faab', 'amount', item.faab_amount) END
    || jsonb_build_object('fromMemberId', item.from_member_id, 'toMemberId', item.to_member_id) ORDER BY item.id), '[]')
    AS value FROM public.trade_items item JOIN chosen trade ON trade.id=item.trade_id LEFT JOIN player_data player ON player.id = item.player_id
    LEFT JOIN public.draft_picks pick ON pick.id = item.pick_id AND pick.league_id=p_league_id LEFT JOIN public.league_members original ON original.id = pick.original_owner_id AND original.league_id=p_league_id
    LEFT JOIN public.snake_draft_picks slot ON slot.draft_pick_id=pick.id

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(CASE WHEN trade.id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object('id', trade.id, 'status', trade.status, 'completionFailureReason', trade.completion_failure_reason,

WITH pgrst_source AS (SELECT pgrst_call.pgrst_scalar FROM (SELECT $1 AS json_data) pgrst_payload, LATERAL (SELECT "p_league_id", "p_member_id", "p_params" FROM json_to_record(pgrst_payload.json_data) AS _("p_league_id" uuid, "p_member_id" uuid, "p_params" jsonb) LIMIT 1) pgrst_body , LATERAL (SELECT "public"."view_league"("p_league_id" := pgrst_body."p_league_id", "p_member_id" := pgrst_body."p_member_id", "p_params" := pgrst_body."p_params") pgrst_scalar) pgrst_call) SELECT null::bigint AS total_result_set, 1 AS page_total, coalesce(json_agg(_postgrest_t.pgrst_scalar)->0, 'null') AS body, nullif(current_setting('response.headers', true), '') AS response_headers, nullif(current_setting('response.status', true), '') AS response_status, '' AS response_inserted FROM (SELECT "view_league".* FROM "pgrst_source" AS "view_league"   LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3) _postgrest_t

),
week_ctx AS (

   AND sw.week_end >= args.game_date
  LIMIT 1
),
base_players AS (
  SELECT
    p.id,
    COALESCE(p.display_name, concat_ws(' ', p.first_name, p.last_name)) AS display_name,
    p.nba_team,
    p.position::text AS "position",
    ARRAY(SELECT pos::text FROM unnest(p.eligible_positions) AS pos) AS eligible_positions,
    p.injury_status,
    p.headshot_url,
    p.nba_id
  FROM (

  ) p
),
regular_games AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT id, game_date, home_team, away_team, game_time, status, started_at
  FROM public.nba_games
  WHERE season_year = p_season_year AND public.is_regular_season_game_id(nba_game_id)
),
upcoming_games AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT ng.id, ng.game_date, ng.home_team, ng.away_team, ng.game_time
  FROM args
  JOIN regular_games ng

   AND (ng.started_at IS NULL OR ng.started_at > now())
),
team_next_games AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (teams.nba_team) teams.nba_team, g.game_date, g.home_team, g.away_team, g.game_time

next_games AS (

    true AS projection_is_fresh,
    CASE WHEN args.view_name = 'week_avg' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS priority
  FROM args
  JOIN league l ON true
  LEFT JOIN week_ctx wc ON true
  JOIN public.fantasypros_projection_rows r
    ON r.projection_type = 'weekly_avg'
   AND r.match_status = 'matched'
   AND r.player_id IS NOT NULL
   AND r.season_year = p_season_year

  JOIN base_players projected_player
    ON projected_player.id = avg.player_id
  LEFT JOIN week_game_counts wgc
    ON wgc.player_id = avg.player_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT CASE
      WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' THEN COALESCE(wgc.scheduled_games, 0)::numeric
      ELSE 1::numeric
    END AS games_multiplier
  ) m
),
candidate_union AS (
  SELECT * FROM daily_candidates
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM weekly_total_candidates
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM weekly_avg_candidates
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM internal_candidates
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM season_avg_candidates
),
fallback_best AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (cu.player_id) cu.*
  FROM candidate_union cu
  ORDER BY cu.player_id, cu.priority ASC, cu.projection_fetched_at DESC NULLS LAST
),
sleeper_games AS (
  SELECT r.*, public.projection_stat_fantasy_points(
    r.points, r.rebounds, r.assists, r.steals, r.blocks, r.three_pointers_made, r.turnovers,
    r.field_goals_made, r.field_goals_attempted, r.free_throws_made, r.free_throws_attempted,
    r.double_doubles, r.triple_doubles, l.scoring_settings
  ) AS fantasy_points, r.team IS DISTINCT FROM bp.nba_team AS prior_team_game
  FROM public.sleeper_projection_rows r
  JOIN base_players bp ON bp.id = r.player_id
  LEFT JOIN next_games ng ON ng.player_id=bp.id
  JOIN league l ON true
  CROSS JOIN args
  LEFT JOIN week_ctx wc ON true
  WHERE r.season_year = p_season_year
    AND (r.game_date<(now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date OR r.team=bp.nba_team)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (
      SELECT game_date,home_team AS team,away_team AS opponent FROM regular_games
      UNION ALL SELECT game_date,away_team,home_team FROM regular_games
    ) g WHERE g.game_date=r.game_date AND g.team=r.team AND g.opponent=r.opponent)
    AND (args.view_name = 'today' AND r.game_date = COALESCE(ng.next_game_date,args.game_date)
      OR args.view_name <> 'today' AND r.week_number = wc.week_number)
),
sleeper_totals AS (
  SELECT player_id, count(*)::integer AS games, count(*) FILTER(WHERE prior_team_game)::integer AS prior_team_games,
    sum(fantasy_points) AS fantasy_points,
    sum(points) AS points, sum(rebounds) AS rebounds, sum(assists) AS assists,
    sum(steals) AS steals, sum(blocks) AS blocks, sum(three_pointers_made) AS three_pointers_made,
    sum(turnovers) AS turnovers, sum(minutes) AS minutes,
    100 * sum(field_goals_made) / NULLIF(sum(field_goals_attempted),0) AS field_goal_pct,
    100 * sum(free_throws_made) / NULLIF(sum(free_throws_attempted),0) AS free_throw_pct,
    max(fetched_at) AS fetched_at, min(game_date) AS game_date, min(week_number) AS week_number
  FROM sleeper_games GROUP BY player_id
),
sleeper_candidates AS (
  SELECT s.player_id, 'sleeper'::text AS projection_source, 'Sleeper (RotoWire)'::text AS projection_source_label,
    args.view_name AS projection_view,
    ROUND((s.fantasy_points + COALESCE(b.projection_fantasy_points * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor,2) AS projection_fantasy_points,
    (s.minutes + COALESCE(b.projection_minutes * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor AS projection_minutes,
    (s.points + COALESCE(b.projection_points * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor AS projection_points,
    (s.rebounds + COALESCE(b.projection_rebounds * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor AS projection_rebounds,
    (s.assists + COALESCE(b.projection_assists * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor AS projection_assists,
    (s.steals + COALESCE(b.projection_steals * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor AS projection_steals,
    (s.blocks + COALESCE(b.projection_blocks * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor AS projection_blocks,
    (s.three_pointers_made + COALESCE(b.projection_three_pointers_made * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor AS projection_three_pointers_made,
    (s.turnovers + COALESCE(b.projection_turnovers * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor AS projection_turnovers,
    s.games + CASE WHEN b.player_id IS NOT NULL THEN m.missing_games ELSE 0 END AS projection_games_played,
    (COALESCE(s.field_goal_pct,0)*s.games + COALESCE(b.projection_field_goal_pct,0)*m.missing_games) /
      NULLIF(s.games + CASE WHEN b.projection_field_goal_pct IS NOT NULL THEN m.missing_games ELSE 0 END,0) AS projection_field_goal_pct,
    (COALESCE(s.free_throw_pct,0)*s.games + COALESCE(b.projection_free_throw_pct,0)*m.missing_games) /
      NULLIF(s.games + CASE WHEN b.projection_free_throw_pct IS NOT NULL THEN m.missing_games ELSE 0 END,0) AS projection_free_throw_pct,
    NULL::text AS projection_status, s.fetched_at AS projection_fetched_at,
    CASE WHEN args.view_name='today' THEN s.game_date ELSE NULL::date END AS projection_date,
    s.week_number AS projection_week_number, s.fetched_at>=now()-interval '36 hours' AS projection_is_fresh, 0 AS priority
  FROM sleeper_totals s CROSS JOIN args
  LEFT JOIN fallback_best b ON b.player_id=s.player_id
  LEFT JOIN week_game_counts wgc ON wgc.player_id=s.player_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT CASE WHEN args.view_name='today' THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(COALESCE(wgc.scheduled_games,0)+s.prior_team_games-s.games,0) END AS missing_games
  ) missing
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT missing.missing_games,
      CASE WHEN args.view_name='week_total' THEN missing.missing_games::numeric / NULLIF(b.projection_games_played,0)
        ELSE missing.missing_games::numeric END AS missing_fraction,
      CASE WHEN args.view_name='week_avg' THEN s.games + CASE WHEN b.player_id IS NOT NULL THEN missing.missing_games ELSE 0 END
        ELSE 1 END::numeric AS divisor
  ) m
),
best AS (
  SELECT * FROM sleeper_candidates
  UNION ALL SELECT b.* FROM fallback_best b WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sleeper_candidates s WHERE s.player_id=b.player_id)
)

SELECT
  bp.id AS player_id,
  bp.display_name,
  bp.nba_team,
  bp."position",
  bp.eligible_positions,
  bp.injury_status,
  bp.headshot_url,
  bp.nba_id,
  ng.next_game_date,
  ng.next_game_opponent,
  ng.next_game_time,
  b.projection_source,
  b.projection_source_label,
  b.projection_view,
  b.projection_fantasy_points,
  b.projection_minutes,
  b.projection_points,
  b.projection_rebounds,
  b.projection_assists,
  b.projection_steals,
  b.projection_blocks,
  b.projection_three_pointers_made,
  b.projection_turnovers,
  b.projection_games_played,
  b.projection_field_goal_pct,
  b.projection_free_throw_pct,
  b.projection_status,
  b.projection_fetched_at,
  COALESCE(b.projection_date, ng.next_game_date) AS projection_date,
  b.projection_week_number,
  b.projection_is_fresh
FROM args
JOIN base_players bp ON true
LEFT JOIN best b ON b.player_id = bp.id
LEFT JOIN next_games ng ON ng.player_id = bp.id
WHERE b.player_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY b.projection_fantasy_points DESC NULLS LAST, bp.display_name ASC, bp.id ASC
LIMIT (SELECT page_limit FROM args)
OFFSET (SELECT page_offset FROM args)

WITH pgrst_source AS (SELECT pgrst_call.pgrst_scalar FROM (SELECT $1 AS json_data) pgrst_payload, LATERAL (SELECT "p_league_id", "p_member_id", "p_params" FROM json_to_record(pgrst_payload.json_data) AS _("p_league_id" uuid, "p_member_id" uuid, "p_params" jsonb) LIMIT 1) pgrst_body , LATERAL (SELECT "public"."view_roster"("p_league_id" := pgrst_body."p_league_id", "p_member_id" := pgrst_body."p_member_id", "p_params" := pgrst_body."p_params") pgrst_scalar) pgrst_call) SELECT null::bigint AS total_result_set, 1 AS page_total, coalesce(json_agg(_postgrest_t.pgrst_scalar)->0, 'null') AS body, nullif(current_setting('response.headers', true), '') AS response_headers, nullif(current_setting('response.status', true), '') AS response_status, '' AS response_inserted FROM (SELECT "view_roster".* FROM "pgrst_source" AS "view_roster"   LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3) _postgrest_t

data.transport: Authenticated PostgREST RPC; response body consumed; 3 warmups; sequential requests

definitions.cold: New browser context with only local auth and selected membership; empty HTTP, service-worker, and app caches.
definitions.warm: Same context reopens the measured route after one completed cold visit.
definitions.meaningfulPaint: Second animation frame after route-specific controls and seeded player text are visible.
definitions.interactive: Elapsed navigation time through a successful day change (Home) or opening Auto-set (Roster). Includes automation response overhead; not Lighthouse TTI.
definitions.initialJs: Decoded bytes of scripts actually loaded for the initial route before the readiness interaction.
